name: Composer Shell
description: Three-column workspace shell for the Composer context-engine app: composition-stack rail (left), active layer canvas (center), files rail (right). Rails are 0px wide until the first lock or a jump past layer 0, then snap to 280px while their content slides and fades in. The center canvas hosts the progress hairline, active layer header, locked-context card stack, a swappable per-layer canvas slot, the composer footer, and a future-preview card stack.

OnLayerRowClick invokes the declared Jump command with the row index; ShellModel.Jump sets ActiveIndex and ActiveCanvas.SyncSlot re-hosts the canvas for the new active layer.
The Revisit link invokes the declared Revisit command; ShellModel.Revisit moves ActiveIndex to that layer and resets its state to Clean, re-hosting the canvas.

unresolved.question: Should the center column be modeled as a navigation region (uen:Region.Attached) rather than an inline canvas host?
unresolved.reason: Shell.xaml and ActiveCanvas comments both say the center column is intended to become a uen:Region.Attached navigation surface and that Pages + RouteMap stay registered as scaffolding, but the shipped code hosts the canvas directly via SyncSlot. Only the implemented behavior is asserted here.

unresolved.question: Do the eight per-layer canvases hosted in CanvasSlot belong in this graph or in per-layer graphs?
unresolved.reason: They are swappable content under Views/Layers and were declared out of scope for this run; the slot records the hosted type names but no layer structure is modeled.

unresolved.question: Are SerifItalicFontFamily and SerifLightItalicFontFamily one token or two?
unresolved.reason: Both keys are declared, both are consumed by this surface, and both resolve to the same InterVariable-Italic file — the 'light' distinction is a legacy alias with no measurable difference.
possibleValues: one token with two resource keys

unresolved.question: Is AppTitleRow part of the shipped surface?
unresolved.reason: It is instantiated and bound in ActiveCanvas.xaml but declared Visibility=Collapsed with a comment saying the reset affordance will resurface elsewhere. Modeled as present-but-hidden rather than deleted or asserted as visible.

unresolved.question: Should the reduced-motion path be a state or a rendering preference?
unresolved.reason: MotionPreferences.AnimationsEnabled short-circuits every storyboard to its end values. It changes how a state is reached, not what is presented, so it is recorded in state properties instead of as its own state node.

unresolved.question: What model-side transitions do the footer commands produce?
unresolved.reason: The footer dispatches LockAndContinue / GeneratePreview / AcceptAndLock / DiscardEdits / DiscardPreview by name through MvuxCommandInvoker on the page DataContext. ComposerModel's implementations of those commands were not read in this pass, so only the one best-supported trigger edge is asserted and the rest are left unstated.

unresolved.question: Are the collapsed ActiveLayerHeader TextBlocks (LayerLabelText, TitleText, SubtitleText) dead presentation to be removed?
unresolved.reason: They are declared with Visibility=Collapsed purely so existing code-behind assignments compile; the header's rendered surface is the recap row plus the state badge. Recorded as properties, not as nodes.

unresolved.question: Is RailsVisible better modeled as one screen-level state or as the four per-node states used here?
unresolved.reason: One condition (locked layers > 0 || ActiveIndex > 0) drives four different local presentations. Modeled per affected node per the state-attachment rule, but a single screen-level 'workspace open' state is a defensible alternative.

metadata.scope: Composer shell surface only — Views/Layers/* canvases and the style dictionaries serving them are out of scope
